message: FORGE-VENDOR-1.1 requires a passing init-adopt-upgrade agreement test, but adopt still wholesale-copies skills and adopt.py is outside this stage scope because routing adopt is assigned to FORGE-VENDOR-1.2; a truthful command-agreement test cannot pass in this stage.

notes: Correct catch. The three-command agreement test is moved to FORGE-VENDOR-1.2 (after adopt is routed). In THIS stage (1.1): define the harness-owned skill set (forge) once, route init and re-express upgrade's CLAUDE_HARNESS_OWNED on it, and add test_init_and_upgrade_share_the_harness_owned_skill_set asserting those TWO read the one shared definition (no second hard-coded 'forge' list). Do NOT touch adopt.py (that is 1.2's scope). The full init+adopt+upgrade agreement test is a required test of 1.2.
